Roskilde is a Danish municipality mentioned in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark) [^src1]. The report evaluates clinical quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation, and Roskilde is included in the detailed municipal breakdowns used for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. Specifically, Roskilde's data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is featured in the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant treatment [^src1]. This statistical data is presented in a table on page 94 of the report [^src1]. Beyond its inclusion in this dataset, no further narrative details, claims, relationships, or timeline events regarding the municipality are documented in the provided text.
